The delayed supply-contraction breakout is admitted only when the completed cross-sectional 20-session median return is at least the completed 60-session median return, indicating recent broad acceleration rather than a decelerating rebound. The fast-capitulation reversal remains restricted to a broad bear state with improving breadth.
